mutants.why: loadRejectsFileTruncatedDuringRead changes the pinned file after its size snapshot and requires the exact changed-during-read refusal.
loadRejectsDirectorySwapBeforeFileOpen replaces the validated directory with a junction before CreateFileW; the opened file parent must still be the pinned root.
savePinsDirectoryAgainstSwap requires the open destination directory to block a rename/junction replacement for the whole write and commit.
saveRejectsPayloadBeyondLoadCeiling fills all bounded records and requires save to refuse a payload its own loader cannot admit.
loadRejectsNonObjectRootExplicitly requires valid array JSON to report the root-shape error, never QJsonParseError::NoError or a later envelope error.
loadRejectsForgedDisableWithoutFailure supplies a future disable with no failure timestamp or threshold count and requires whole-ledger refusal.
snapshotOrdersRecordsByKey requires alpha then zeta regardless of QHash iteration order.
